n841c3b96a41.s: About 40 million hectares of India is flood-prone. Roughly what share of India's land is this?
n841c3b96a41.x: About 40 million ha is flood-prone, which is about 12% of the land, not 40%.

n80f573ab5b5.s: How many seismic zones does India's official IS 1893 (BIS) zoning map presently have?
n80f573ab5b5.x: The official map has four zones: II, III, IV and V.

n8779dbd19f2.s: What happened to the proposed revision of India's seismic zoning map in March 2026?
o: It was extended to the islands
It was rolled back by the Centre
It was made binding on new dams only
n8779dbd19f2.x: The Centre rolled the revision back in March 2026 after criticism of its methodology and cost, so the four-zone map still applies.

n701406ccb38.s: Which of the following disaster – year pairs is NOT correctly matched?
n701406ccb38.x: The Indian Ocean Tsunami struck in 2004; Koyna was 1967, Killari 1993 and Bhuj 2001.

n5371a209688.s: The Western Ghats and Nilgiris are landslide-prone mainly because of:
n5371a209688.x: Steep escarpments and orographic rain make the Western Ghats and Nilgiris landslide-prone, not permafrost.

nac94f016892.s: Polavaram district of Andhra Pradesh was created mainly for:
o: Rehabilitation and resettlement of Polavaram-project villages
nac94f016892.x: Polavaram district was created for the R&R of Polavaram-project villages, not for Rayalaseema.

n04a875fff54.s: As on 31 December 2025, how many districts did Andhra Pradesh have?
n04a875fff54.x: AP had 28 districts, including the new Markapuram (from western Prakasam) and Polavaram.

ndebf8ff960e.s: In the 2022 arrangement of 26 districts, how many districts did Rayalaseema have?
ndebf8ff960e.x: Rayalaseema had 8 districts, Uttarandhra 6 and the rest of Coastal Andhra 12.

nap-geography-14-1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about bird sanctuaries of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Kolleru–Atapaka is a freshwater wetland between the Godavari and Krishna deltas
Pulicat Lake is a brackish-water lagoon
Kondakarla Ava is a freshwater lake near Anakapalle
nap-geography-14-1.x: Rollapadu is dry grassland for the Great Indian Bustard, not a lagoon.

nindian-geography-12-7.s:
Arrange the following hill ranges from north to south:
1. Seshachalam Hills
2. Kaimur Range
3. Biligirirangan Hills
4. Nallamalai Hills
nindian-geography-12-7.x: The Kaimur Range (MP, UP, Bihar) is northernmost, then Nallamalai (AP–Telangana), Seshachalam (southern AP) and Biligirirangan (south-east Karnataka).

nap-geography-21-6.s:
Consider the following statements about waterfalls of Andhra Pradesh:
1. Talakona is the tallest waterfall in Andhra Pradesh.
2. Ethipothala Falls flows into the Nagarjuna Sagar reservoir.
3. Kailasakona Falls lies in the Araku region.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nap-geography-21-6.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Kailasakona is near Nagari and linked to the Kailasanatha Swamy temple; Katiki is the Araku-region fall.

new.s: In which seismic zone does Delhi lie?
new.x: Delhi lies in Seismic Zone IV.

new.s: The Amaravati core capital region of Andhra Pradesh falls in which seismic zone?
new.x: Amaravati, with Vijayawada and Guntur, is in Zone III; AP has no Zone V area.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT in Seismic Zone V?
new.x: Delhi is in Zone IV; Kutch, the North-East and Andaman and Nicobar are in Zone V.

new.s: The proposed, later withdrawn, revision of India's seismic zoning map added which new zone?
new.x: The PSHA-based revision added a Zone VI, but it was withdrawn in March 2026.

new.s: Which Indian Standard lays down seismic design criteria and carries India's seismic zoning map?
new.x: IS 1893 covers seismic design criteria and the zoning map; IS 13920 covers ductile detailing.

new.s: The Vulnerability Atlas of India is published by:
new.x: The Vulnerability Atlas is published by the Building Materials and Technology Promotion Council (BMTPC).

new.s: The 1967 Koyna earthquake in Maharashtra is the classic Indian case of:
new.x: Koyna (1967) is the classic reservoir-induced earthquake; Killari (1993) was intraplate.

new.s: Liquefaction hazard during earthquakes is associated mainly with which region of India?
new.x: The soft alluvium of the Indo-Gangetic plain carries the liquefaction hazard.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about earthquakes in India:
1. The Killari earthquake of 1993 was an intraplate earthquake.
2. The Bhuj earthquake struck Kutch on 26 January 2001.
3. The Koyna earthquake of 1967 occurred in Gujarat.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; Koyna is in Maharashtra, not Gujarat.

new.s: The Kedarnath disaster of June 2013 in Uttarakhand was a:
new.x: Kedarnath (June 2013) was a cloudburst and flash flood.

new.s: Which of the following disaster – type pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Chamoli (2021) was a rock-ice flood; Kedarnath was a cloudburst, Badrinath an avalanche and Koyna reservoir-induced.

new.s: About what share of India's landmass is prone to moderate-to-high earthquakes (NDMA, 2023)?
new.x: About 59% of India's landmass is prone to moderate-to-high earthquakes.

new.s: About what share of India's cultivable area is vulnerable to drought?
new.x: About 68% of the cultivable area is drought-vulnerable.

new.s: About how much of India's ~7,516 km coastline is exposed to cyclones and tsunamis?
new.x: About 5,700 km of the ~7,516 km coastline is exposed to cyclones and tsunamis.

new.s: The Bay of Bengal generates roughly how many times as many cyclones as the Arabian Sea?
new.x: The Bay of Bengal produces about four times as many cyclones, so the east coast is hit far more.

new.s: How many coastal districts of India are cyclone-affected?
new.x: 84 coastal districts in 13 coastal States/UTs are cyclone-affected.

new.s: INCOIS, which houses the Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre, works under which ministry?
new.x: INCOIS has been an autonomous body under the Ministry of Earth Sciences since 1999.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about disaster centres:
1. UNESCO-IOC is headquartered at Paris.
2. ITIC is located at Hyderabad.
3. UNDRR is located at Geneva.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; ITIC is at Honolulu, not Hyderabad.

new.s: Landslide Hazard Zonation maps are best described as:
o: Exact forecasts of the time of landslides
Exact forecasts of the place of landslides
Probabilistic maps showing likelihood of landslides
new.x: Zonation maps are probabilistic: they show likelihood, not the exact time or place of a landslide.

new.s: The southern limit of Andhra Pradesh lies at about which latitude?
new.x: AP extends from about 12°41' N to 19°07' N.

new.s: Which State borders Andhra Pradesh on the north-east?
new.x: Odisha lies to the north-east; Chhattisgarh to the north and Telangana to the north-west.

new.s: The longitudinal extent of Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: AP extends from about 77° E to 84°40' E.

new.s: Which of the following States does NOT share a border with Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: AP borders Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu; Kerala is not a neighbour.

new.s: Belum Caves, the second-largest known cave in the subcontinent, are in which district?
new.x: Belum Caves are in Kolimigundla mandal of Nandyal district.

new.s: Gandikota, called the 'Grand Canyon of India', is a gorge of which river?
new.x: Gandikota is the Penna (Pennar) gorge in the Erramala hills of YSR Kadapa.

new.s: Billa Surgam Caves, a prehistoric site near Betamcherla, are in which district?
new.x: Billa Surgam Caves are in Kurnool district near Betamcherla.

new.s: The limestone Borra Caves of the Araku Valley lie in which hills?
new.x: Borra Caves are limestone karst caves in the Ananthagiri hills, on the Gosthani river.

new.s: After the December 2025 reorganisation, Andhra Pradesh has about how many mandals?
new.x: AP has about 688 mandals and 81 revenue divisions across 28 districts.

new.s: About how many revenue divisions does Andhra Pradesh have across its 28 districts?
new.x: After December 2025 AP has about 81 revenue divisions.

new.s: How many mandals does the re-formed West Godavari district have?
new.x: West Godavari has 19 mandals; Parvathipuram Manyam 15 and Polavaram 11.

new.s: What is the headquarters of Palnadu district?
new.x: Palnadu's headquarters is Narasaraopet, not Nandyal.

new.s: Which of the following district – headquarters pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: West Godavari's headquarters is Bhimavaram; Palnadu's is Narasaraopet and ASR's is Paderu.

new.s: After December 2025, which is the largest district of Andhra Pradesh by area?
new.x: YSR Kadapa (~12,507 sq km) is largest now; Prakasam was largest in the 26-district map.

new.s: Alluri Sitharama Raju district has its headquarters at:
new.x: The headquarters of Alluri Sitharama Raju district is Paderu.

new.s: Which of the following districts does NOT belong to Rayalaseema?
new.x: Palnadu is a coastal district; Annamayya, Sri Sathya Sai and Nandyal are in Rayalaseema.

new.s: How many mandals of Khammam were transferred to Andhra Pradesh in 2014 for the Polavaram project?
new.x: Seven Polavaram-affected mandals of Khammam were moved to AP by the 2014 ordinance and amendment Act.

new.s: The seven Khammam mandals transferred to Andhra Pradesh in 2014 now lie in which district?
new.x: These mandals now lie in Polavaram district (Chinturu division).

new.s: India's first private-sector gold mine, Jonnagiri, is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Jonnagiri, in Kurnool district, is India's first private-sector gold mine.

new.s: Asia's first rubber dam, in Andhra Pradesh, was built on which river?
new.x: It was built on the Janjavathi, a tributary of the Nagavali.

new.s: Before the 2014 bifurcation, undivided Andhra Pradesh covered about:
new.x: Undivided AP (1956–2014) covered about 2,75,000 sq km; today's AP is 1,62,970 sq km.

new.s: The coastal plains of Andhra Pradesh are about how long?
new.x: The coastal plains are about 950 km long and about 60 km wide.

new.s: In the recalculated coastline figures, 1,068.69 km is the coastline of:
new.x: 1,068.69 km is Tamil Nadu's coastline; AP's is 1,053.07 km.

new.s: After the 2023-24 remeasurement, Andhra Pradesh's coastline ranks ____ in India.
new.x: AP's 1,053.07 km is 3rd after Gujarat and Tamil Nadu, though still the longest on the east coast.

new.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh has the shortest coastline (about 23 km)?
new.x: West Godavari has the shortest district coast (23 km); Srikakulam the longest (193 km).

new.s: After 2022, how many districts of Andhra Pradesh touch the coast?
new.x: 12 districts touch the coast after the 2022 reorganisation.

new.s: The Krishna delta spreads mainly over which districts?
new.x: The Krishna delta covers Krishna, Guntur and Bapatla districts.

new.s: The Penna river meets the Bay of Bengal at:
new.x: The Penna's mouth is at Utukuru in Nellore, not at Pulicat.

new.s: The Undavalli Caves near Vijayawada are:
new.x: Undavalli in Guntur has rock-cut, monolithic caves with a four-storey temple.

new.s: Which of the following cave – district pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Undavalli Caves are in Guntur near Vijayawada; the other three pairs are correct.

new.s: Lambasingi hill station is in which district?
new.x: Lambasingi is at Chintapalle in Alluri Sitharama Raju district.

new.s: After the 2025 reorganisation, Maredumilli hill station lies in which district?
new.x: Maredumilli (Rampachodavaram agency division) is now in Polavaram district.

new.s: Which of the following hill station – district pairs is NOT correctly matched?
new.x: Lambasingi is in Alluri Sitharama Raju (Chintapalle), not Tirupati.

new.s: The Western plateau (Rayalaseema) of Andhra Pradesh lies mostly at what height?
new.x: The Western plateau is 150–600 m high, with crystalline rocks and red soils.

new.s: The coast south of the Krishna river is called the:
new.x: South of the Krishna is the Coromandel Coast; north of it is the Northern Circars.

new.s: Which State has the second largest mangrove cover in India (ISFR 2023)?
new.x: Gujarat, not AP, has the second largest mangrove cover.

new.s: The Krishna Wildlife Sanctuary protects mangroves at the:
new.x: Krishna WLS protects the Krishna estuary mangroves; Coringa is on the Godavari estuary.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra coastal plain:
1. It belongs to the emergent Eastern Coastal Plain built by river deposition.
2. It runs from Mahendragiri in the north to Pulicat Lake in the south.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the AP coast is part of the emergent, depositional Eastern Coastal Plain, ~950 km from Mahendragiri to Pulicat.

new.s: The Velikonda range, easternmost of the southern ranges, lies mainly in:
new.x: Velikonda lies in SPSR Nellore–Tirupati (Prakasam side).

new.s: The Papikondalu hills are associated with the gorge of which river?
new.x: Papikondalu lies in the Godavari districts along the Godavari gorge, not the Krishna.

new.s: The Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve covers about:
new.x: NSTR (est. 1983) covers about 3,728 sq km in the Nallamala and is India's largest tiger reserve.

new.s: Which Puducherry enclave lies in the Godavari delta of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Yanam (30 sq km), part of Puducherry, is an enclave in the Godavari delta.
